title: 第481章 你是不是做了什么对不起我的事第480章 宇宙天才榜
content_zh:
许小凡心中暗自思忖。
这一次，为了老爹的伤，他无论如何，都得晋升前十。
不过，这其中，却也不是没有漏洞可钻。
既然这宇宙天才榜为期十年才定榜。
那自己完全可以先老老实实苟个十年。
再一举战败前十。
这样，前十的名额保住了。
自己也不需要冒着如此之大的风险，四处征战，一举两得！
一念至此。
许小凡的嘴角，不由勾起一抹微笑。
就在此时。
虚空深处那张榜单开始出现变化，绽放出道道神光。
“这是放初榜了！”
石皓月惊喜道。
初榜？
许小凡闻言，不由疑惑的看向石皓月。
犹豫了一下，他问道：
“前辈，这初榜是什么？”
石皓月道：
“所谓初榜，其实便是那几位巅峰存在，逆观岁月长河，找出一百位天赋足够上榜的天骄，先记录在榜单之上。”

“这便是所谓的初榜。”
“当然，往往这初榜，也并非是最终的排名。”
闻言，许小凡微微点头。
十年，对于一些人来说，可能是眨眼一瞬。
可对于那些真正的天骄来说，这十年时间，却有着无限的可能。
石皓月接着道：
“据我所知，除了我荒古神国外，这一代，三大圣地，五大神国中的年轻一辈天骄，可都比之前几代，强上了不知多少！”
“还有一些大势力，生怕自家天骄提前陨落，还特地将天骄给隐藏了起来。”
“这一次的宇宙天才战，想必相当精彩。”
“也不知，此次初榜，谁能独领风骚......”
随着神光出现，空白的榜单上，浮现出一个个名字。
第一眼。
许小凡便看见了一道有些熟悉的名字。
宇宙天骄榜第一，星辰圣地，圣子辰坤！
许小凡盯着那个名字。
眼中闪过一丝若有若无的杀意。
这不就是当日派人前来，想收剑雨竹做妾的那位圣子吗？
这等淫贼，竟能排到榜一？
石皓月此时却惊呼道：
“没想到这次初榜第一，竟是这位号称北王的的辰坤！”

许小凡问道：
“前辈，这位北王辰坤，什么实力？”
石皓月表情凝重道：
content_en:
Xu Xiaofan thought to himself.
This time, for his father's injury, he had to advance to the top ten no matter what.
However, there are not no loopholes to exploit.
Since the universe genius list is determined for ten years.
Then I can just live it out for ten years.
Defeated the top ten in one fell swoop.
In this way, the top ten spots are saved.
There is no need for him to take such a big risk and fight everywhere to achieve two birds with one stone!
This is the thought.
The corner of Xu Xiaofan's mouth couldn't help but evoke a smile.
Right now.
The list in the depths of the void began to change, blooming with divine light.
"This is the first time the list has been released!"
Shi Haoyue said in surprise.
First time?
When Xu Xiaofan heard this, he couldn't help but look at Shi Haoyue in confusion.
After hesitating for a moment, he asked:
"Senior, what is this first list?"
Shi Haoyue said:
"The so-called first list is actually those peak beings. Looking back over the years, we will find a hundred talented people who are talented enough to be on the list, and record them on the list first."
"This is the so-called first list."
"Of course, often this preliminary ranking is not the final ranking."
Hearing this, Xu Xiaofan nodded slightly.
Ten years, for some, may be the blink of an eye.
But for those true geniuses, these ten years hold endless possibilities.
Shi Haoyue continued:
"As far as I know, except for our ancient kingdom, this generation, the younger generation of geniuses in the three major holy lands and the five major divine kingdoms are all much better than the previous generations!"
"There are also some big forces who are afraid that their genius will fall prematurely, so they deliberately hide their genius."
"This battle of cosmic geniuses must be quite exciting."
"I don't know who can take the lead in this first ranking..."
As the divine light appeared, names appeared one after another on the blank list.
First glance.
Xu Xiaofan saw a somewhat familiar name.
Number one on the list of geniuses in the universe, Holy Land of Stars, Holy Son Chen Kun!
Xu Xiaofan stared at the name.
A hint of murderous intent flashed in his eyes.
Isn't this the same Holy Son who sent people here that day to accept Sword Yuzhu as his concubine?
How could such a lewd thief be ranked first on the list?
Shi Haoyue exclaimed at this time:
"I didn't expect that the number one on the first list this time would be Chen Kun, who is known as the King of the North!"
Xu Xiaofan asked:
"Senior, what is the strength of this Northern King Chenkun?"
